title: Product Fourier basis vectors
statement: Let $m>0$ and let $n$ be a natural number. For every function $\alpha\colon\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z$, the Fourier basis vector indexed by $\alpha$ is the product character indexed by $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ is a function from $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ to $\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z$
